note: Bryant Park and Madison Square Park: sleepers, readers, small dealers (no drug detail).

lines.text: Bench is mine till sunrise. Then it's the pigeons'.
Library's the only building that never asked me to leave.
Park's empty by nine. Everybody in it is buying or watching.
Chess, mister? Quarter a game. I win, you learn.
Cops rousted me twice tonight. Where'm I supposed to sleep?
Rain. Under the trees. Trees leak.
Hot night. Grass is cooler than my room was.
Hey! Watch the feet! These are all I got!
Run! Run! Nobody runs through the park for fun.
Lights out. Stay where people can see you.
Keep walking, mister. Nothing here for you.
Pigeons know me. Pigeons are good people.
